title: Fuse two list filters into one
summary: Replace two successive Boolean filters on a Lean list with one filter using conjunction. The equality preserves the complete output list, including order and repeated elements.

source.statement: ∀ {l}, filter p (filter q l) = filter (fun a => p a && q a) l

assumptions: α : Type u; p q : α → Bool; l : List α. The type, predicates and list are arbitrary, with no additional hypotheses.

reuse: Set lean-toolchain to leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0 and import Init.Data.List.Lemmas. Supply any type α, predicates p q : α → Bool and list l : List α, then apply List.filter_filter. The outer predicate p precedes the inner predicate q in the fused Boolean conjunction.
